description: §38.6.1 — `onserver:message` with more than one parameter in the call expression fires E-CHANNEL-005. Before S460 the rule had no emit site: the program compiled at exit 0 and the server emitted `await handleMessage(msg, extra)` with `extra` a free identifier (a ReferenceError at the first message).
rationale: §38.6.1: "The compiler SHALL emit an error (E-CHANNEL-005) if `onserver:message` contains more than one parameter in the call expression."
